about.title: A small team that builds AI infrastructure meant to last.
about.description: We started Enelope because too many AI projects stall at the prototype stage — impressive in a demo, unreliable in production. We work end to end: consulting on where automation fits, building the agents and chatbots, and standing up the cloud infrastructure underneath.

values.title: Honest scoping
values.body: We turn down work we don't think will pay off, and we say so before the invoice, not after.

values.title: Production over demos
values.body: A prototype that impresses in a meeting and an agent that survives real traffic are different projects. We build the second one.

values.title: Ownership transfer
values.body: You should be able to run what we build without us. Documentation and handoff are part of every engagement.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: This policy explains what information Enelope ("we", "us") collects through enelope.ch, how we use it, and who we share it with. It covers this website only — separate agreements govern any client engagement or project work.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.intro: We collect information in two ways:

bullets.label: Contact form.
bullets.body: When you submit the contact form, we receive the name, email, company, phone number, service of interest, and message you provide.

bullets.label: Basic hosting logs.
bullets.body: Our hosting provider (Vercel) automatically logs standard request data (such as IP address and browser type) for security and reliability. We do not use analytics or advertising trackers on this site.

sections.outro: Your theme preference (light or dark mode) is stored locally in your browser and never sent to us.

sections.heading: How we use your information
sections.body: We use contact form submissions solely to respond to your inquiry. We do not sell your personal data, and we do not use it for marketing unless you separately opt in.

sections.heading: Third-party service providers
sections.intro: We rely on a small number of subprocessors to run this site and deliver contact form messages:

providers.name: Supabase
providers.body: hosts our database, authentication, and file storage for the services and testimonials shown on this site

providers.name: Resend
providers.body: delivers the email generated when you submit the contact form

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: We don't use tracking or advertising cookies. Signing into the admin panel sets a secure, necessary session cookie used only to keep you authenticated.

sections.heading: Data retention
sections.body: Contact form submissions are emailed directly to our team and are not stored in a database. Services and testimonials content is retained in our database until removed by an administrator.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask us what information we hold about you, or request that we delete it, by emailing {email}.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be reflected by updating the date at the top of this page.

sections.heading: Acceptance of terms
sections.body: By using enelope.ch (the "Site"), you agree to these terms. These terms govern use of the Site only — they don't govern any paid engagement with Enelope, which is covered by a separate signed agreement or statement of work.

sections.heading: Use of the site
sections.body: The Site is provided for informational purposes — to describe our services, share case studies, and let you get in touch. You agree not to misuse the Site, including attempting to gain unauthorized access to the admin panel or any other non-public part of the Site.

sections.heading: Engaging our services
sections.body: Descriptions of services on this Site are informational and do not constitute an offer or contract. Project scope, pricing, deliverables, and ownership of work product for any engagement are defined exclusively in a separate written agreement between Enelope and the client.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
sections.body: The Site's content, design, and the Enelope name and logo are owned by Enelope and may not be copied or reused without permission. This does not apply to deliverables produced under a separate client agreement, which is governed by that agreement's IP terms.

sections.heading: No warranty
sections.body: The Site is provided "as is," without warranties of any kind. We don't guarantee the Site will be uninterrupted, error-free, or available at all times.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
sections.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Enelope is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the Site.

sections.heading: Third-party services
sections.body: The Site relies on third-party providers (Supabase, Resend, Vercel) to operate. We aren't responsible for outages or issues originating from those providers.

sections.heading: Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Switzerland, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Material changes will be reflected by updating the date at the top of this page.
